_comment: Stage 3 手写兜底例句：这些词在 Tatoeba 里的英文句要么没有中文对照、要么中文句里夹着拉丁字母（人名/品牌名），22 号选不出合格例句，由静态数据补（零成本、无 LLM）。格式与 words-examples.json / words-examples-stage2.json 一致，22 号按 Stage 1 → 2 → 3 的顺序合并，同名词以更晚的为准。注意：例句中除句首和 I 之外的任何大写词都会被 22 号当成专名拦下，月份（June）也算。

weekday.exampleEn: I take the bus to work on every weekday.
weekday.exampleCn: 我每个工作日都坐公交车上班。

grandchild.exampleEn: She is taking care of her grandchild.

tenth.exampleEn: She finished tenth in the race.
tenth.exampleCn: 她在比赛中得了第十名。

background.exampleEn: He has a background in medicine.

northwards.exampleEn: The birds flew northwards for the winter.

oilfield.exampleEn: They found a large oilfield in the desert.
oilfield.exampleCn: 他们在沙漠里发现了一个大油田。

calibration.exampleEn: The calibration of the instrument takes a few minutes.
calibration.exampleCn: 这台仪器的校准要花几分钟。

deformation.exampleEn: The deformation of the metal was clearly visible.

despatch.exampleEn: We will despatch the goods tomorrow morning.

interconnect.exampleEn: These two systems interconnect through a shared cable.
interconnect.exampleCn: 这两个系统通过一根共用电缆互连。

maturation.exampleEn: The maturation of the fruit takes several weeks.
maturation.exampleCn: 果实的成熟需要好几周。

predominant.exampleEn: Blue is the predominant colour in this room.
predominant.exampleCn: 蓝色是这个房间的主色调。

resultant.exampleEn: The resultant damage was far worse than expected.
resultant.exampleCn: 由此造成的损失远比预想严重。

southwards.exampleEn: The river flows southwards to the sea.

subdivide.exampleEn: They decided to subdivide the land into four plots.
subdivide.exampleCn: 他们决定把这块地再分成四块。

transverse.exampleEn: Make a transverse cut across the stem.
